decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the structures hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is occupied.

Condition : 4 - The development shall not be occupied until screen planting along the boundaries have been planted in accordance with a scheme submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority in writing.

Condition : 5 - It is considered that the proposed erection of a substation compound, installation of air conditioning units, erection of mezzanine floor, (at 1st floor level) and change of use to telecoms switch facility to the existing commercial building, because of its position, design and appearance would be acceptable having due regard for the site characteristics of  Unit 3, Syon Gate Way and is complimentary to the visual amenity of the locality, and would not be detrimental to the amenities of the adjoining and neighbouring commercial properties.  The development is in accordance with the UDP policies ENVB 1.1 (New Development), E.2.4  - (Improvement of Employment Sites)  and T.1.4 (Car and Cycle Parking and Servicing Facilities for Developments) of the London Borough of Hounslow UDP, Adopted December 2003.
description: Erection of sub station compound, installation of airconditioning units, erection of mezzanine floor (at 1st floor level) and change of use to telecoms switch facility.
